chapter.verse: Tua lai takin Herod kumpipa in pawlpite kimkhat a kibawlsiat theih nadingin thu pia a,
Johan’ sanggampa Jeim namsau tawh a that hi.
Hih thu hangin Judah mite a nuam uh a muh ciangin Piter zong a man hi. Tua lai takin Silngo-omlo Anlum pawikham hun ahi hi.
Amah in Piter a mat khit ciangin galkap li tek a om, galkap pawl li kemsak a, thong sungah a khia hi. Paisan pawi ni a bei khit ciangin mi honpi mai-ah lahkhiat ding a hanciam hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Piter in thong sungah a om lai takin pawlpite in Pasian kiangah amah ading hahkatin thu a ngetsak uh hi.
Herod kumpipa in a lakkhiat hun dek tak ni zanin Piter sikkhau nih tawh kihen a, galkap nih kikalah ihmu a, thong kong mai-ah a cingte in a cing uh hi.
Pasian’ vantungmi khat in ama kiangah ding a, thong inn sungah khuavak a tang hi. Vantungmi in Piter’ pang beeng a, phongin, “Tho mengmeng in,” a cih ciangin sikkhaute a khut tung pan a kitolkhia hi.
Vantungmi in, “Na kawnggak gak in la, na khedap bulh in,” a cih ciangin tua mah bangin a hih hi. “Na puan silh in la, hong zui in,” a ci hi.
Piter paikhia a, vantungmi’ nung a zuih hangin vantungmi ahih takpi lam thei loin, mangmu a kisa hi.

A cingte mun khatna leh mun nihna khengin, khua sungah lutna sik kongpi a tun’ uh ciangin, ama thu thu-in amau ading kihong a, amaute a paikhia uh a, lam khat a pai khit uh ciangin thakhatin vantungmi in Piter tawh kikhenin a paikhia hi.
Piter in khua a phawk khit ciangin, “Topa in vantungmi hong sawl a, Herod kumpipa’ khut leh Judah mite’ lametna sung pan kei hong suaktasak takpi ahih ka thei hi,” a ci hi.
Tua bang a ngaihsut khit ciangin Marka, a min thak Johan’ nu Mari’ innah a pai hi. Tua san takah mi tampi hong kikhawm uh a, thu a ngen uh hi.
Piter in kong a kiuh ciangin Roda min nei nungak khat in va ngai dingin a pai hi.
Amah in Piter’ aw hi cih a theih ciangin a lungdam mahmah a, kong hong loin inn sungah tai a, “Piter kongkhak kiangah a ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Amaute in, “A hai hi teh,” a cih uh ciangin, amah in, “Piter om takpi hi,” a ci teitei hi. Amaute in, “Piter’ vantungmi hi ding hi,” a ci uh hi.
Piter in kong kiu lailai a, amaute in kong a hon’ ciangin a mu uh a, a lungmang uh hi.

Amah in amaute pau lo-a a om na’ngun a khut a vaan khit ciangin Topa in amah thong sung pan bang ci-a lakhia hiam cih thu a gen hi. “Tua thu Jeim leh sawltakte kiangah va gen un,” a cih khit ciangin tua mun pan paikhia a, a mun dangah a pai hi.
A zingsang ciangin Piter koi lamah a om hiam ci-in galkapte in a gamlum uh hi.
Herod in amah zongsak a, a muh loh ciangun a cingte thu a dot khit ciangin a thatsak hi. Tua ciangin amah in Judah gam pan Kaisaria khua-ah paisukin, tua lai-ah tawlkhat a om hi.

Herod kumpipa in Tai-ar leh Sidon khuapihte tungah heh a, amaute in a lungsim kikhatin ama kiangah a pai uh a, mangpa’ thu vaihawmpipa Blatas amau lawma a mat khit uh ciangin kilemna thu a gen uh hi. Bang hang hiam i cih leh, amaute gam in kumpipa gam panin an a ngah uh hi.
A kiciam kholh ni-in Herod in kumpipuan silhin tokhom tungah tu a, amaute kiangah thu a gen hi.
Mi honpite in, “Hih aw in mi’ aw hi lo Pasian’ aw ahi hi!” ci-in a kiko uh hi.
Amah in Pasian’ min phat lo ahih ciangin Pasian’ vantungmi khat in thakhatin amah sat a, thante in a ne uh a, a si hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian’ thu in khangto a, a kizel semsem hi.
Barnabas leh Saul in a sep ding bang bang uh a zawh khit uh ciangun Marka kici a min thak Johan tonpihin, Jerusalem khua panin a ciah uh hi.
